decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's compound wafer and through-substrate structuring capabilities, so related knowledge supports learning and improvement.
This is a minor extension of existing carrier wafer know-how, making it easy to interpret results and apply improvements.
Although copper metallization is newer, it leverages the firm's glass via and packaging wafer expertise and aligns with its stated strategic direction, so absorptive capacity is sufficient.
This brand repackages the firm's core standard wafer business, requiring no new technical knowledge and fitting existing capabilities.
Glass-based circuit boards require circuit-board manufacturing knowledge distant from the firm's wafer processing capabilities, limiting its ability to assimilate results and improve the product.
